title: Tech Note: 4D Mobile Unit Testing (Revised)
author: Xiang Liu, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D Mobile and its Wakanda Studio-based unit-testing framework (Mocha/Chai) have been fully discontinued along with the broader Wakanda platform, so this exact tooling can no longer be used with current 4D. The general principle of unit-testing exposed data-layer operations (CRUD, method calls) with Mocha/Chai-style frameworks remains standard JavaScript testing practice, but must now be applied to 4D's REST/ORDA-based APIs using modern JS test tooling rather than Wakanda Studio.
related_updates: 4D's REST server (ORDA-based) is the modern equivalent surface for exposing data to be tested from JS clients
Mocha/Chai remain popular general JS testing frameworks, but the Wakanda Studio integration described no longer exists
